cases.note: The spec example with docs on several objects and another top-level name: the same canonical form and fingerprint as spec-example.
A type named docs is a name in types, not a docs field: it stays, while its definition's own docs field goes.

The example app's manifest, as pavia-server exports it: the services and types of the spec 12.2 example, without channels or datagrams. The TypeScript client compares its generated fingerprint constant with this one.
"idempotent": false is the default and must be omitted.
"returns": "unit" is the default and must be omitted.
An empty params list equals the default and must be omitted.
"history": false is the default and must be omitted.
An absent field is omitted, never null.
server_methods with send before history: named entries are sorted by name in byte order.
Two client methods named confirm: a sorted list has each name once.
